description: T-4061: every month and weekday name of calendar digits 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, E, F, 10, 11, 14, 16 and 17 under every LCID with a locale and 0xD001 (none): each row is "LCID|digits" then, for each digit in turn, yyyy|m|mmm|mmmm|ddd|dddd of one date per month of that calendar (Hebrew: the common 5783 and the leap 5784) and of dates completing the seven weekdays, joined with "~".
